title: Photo to Storybook Illustration — Kawaii Gouache
summary: Turn a family photo into a sunny kawaii picture-book page in hand-painted gouache, keeping everyone's pose and clothes, with flowers, butterflies, a smiling sun and white doodle outlines.
seoTitle: Photo to Kawaii Storybook Illustration Prompt | Image Prompt Book
seoDescription: Turn a family photo into a hand-painted kawaii storybook illustration that keeps the pose and clothes. Use the original swing prompt or the any-photo version, then copy it.
inputRequirement: Requires one photo. The original version describes a mother and child on a swing; use "Any photo" for other scenes. Attach the photo in your image generation tool; this website does not upload or generate images.
howToUse: Pick "Original (swing)" or "Any photo", and adjust the outline option.
